body:
First-time players now choose a display language before the home menu. Automatic names follow that language when a fresh setup begins and stay fixed throughout setup; names typed by a player stay exact. Existing saved preferences skip the chooser. Control edits keep keyboard focus, confirm successful saves, restore stored values after a save error, and cancel unused key capture when leaving settings or switching windows. Mouse buttons, Space and the left stick have readable labels in all 15 languages.

The branch retains seven classes, 378 skills, 28 weapons, 66 bosses, six maps and five modes; offline Solo, public/private waiting rooms, optional passwords, host-only Start/Pause/Continue, confirmed chat, profiles, boundary saves and server-written team records. The accepted gallery, camera/cover routes, pit-only lava, defeat preparation and Medic/shield rules remain.

Exact source **cb0ca6d3c27d32c0930381334d0dedbb14d4cc7f**, build **2026.10.30-control-settings / protocol 43**, passes **915 tests, 915 pass, 0 fail**, plus TypeScript, authored content/all 15 catalogs/native artwork, production build and 71 atlas contracts. Both complete source CI jobs pass: [124238229390](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/41106682116/job/124238229390) and [124238129997](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/actions/runs/41106652889/job/124238129997). [Source and review evidence](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/control-settings-2026-10-30) preserves complete logs, the restricted-network failed gate, corrected disclosure fixture and the passing final gate. Testing5254/backend2628 and public5255/backend2629 each pass 49 served hashes including all 15 catalogs and actual two-peer room/password/code/localized-name/chat/host/record checks. Wiki **3653ee941878e21c8a3b669dc861969460d1ccd6** matches all 18 pages and 34 images.

The matching [local Windows review](https://github.com/ProgrammingWithYagle/Bullet-Hell-Game-Open-AI-Contest-/tree/feat/first-playable-loop/reviews/windows-control-settings-2026-10-30) verifies all 1899 files before/after six native offline/LAN diagnostics across original, fresh ZIP extraction and independent Japanese-path copy. The 842956715-byte ZIP has SHA-256 **04b7af0e994ead2ec703fe61a6a9e654e725dd158176aa985be37314e5dcd31e**. All older packages, failures and previews remain preserved.

Human/rendered/controller/device/listening/native-language acceptance, complete action art and balance, physical second-computer LAN, WAN/endurance/capacity and deployed shared rankings/recovery remain open. Browser automation is disabled. Alternate covers, bots/story and new gameplay expansion stay deferred. This remains a draft on the feature branch; protected main and the older hosted Site/Windows releases are unchanged.
